description: Explain how to hear a song sung in the person's own voice with Tera Studio, and give them the link to start. They create an account on terastudio.co, sing for about a minute, add a song they have the rights to use, and hear it back in their voice. Use it when someone wants to hear themselves sing a song, make a cover in their own voice, or turn a song into a gift in their voice. It returns steps and a link and creates nothing. Tera Studio only uses the person's own voice: not for celebrity or other people's voices.

language.description: The language the song is sung in, if they said.

occasion.description: What it's for, if they said: a birthday, a wedding, a gift.

song_title.description: The song they want to hear in their voice, if they named one.
